sentences.text: The fix was released in v3.3.2 on 2026-03-19, a hotfix for the dispatch outage described in ticket INC-20260314-07.
The defect was a connection pool leak in the dispatch service, introduced in v3.3.1, which caused the outage when a weekend inventory count raised the number of simultaneous missions.
Connections that timed out while a robot switched access points were not returned to the pool, and v3.3.2 fixed this by returning them to the pool.
